Tachyon

Let's get this done quick, I have an experiment running back at the lab and need to be there!
 
HP: 22
Hand: Sonic Vortex, Pushing the Limits, Supersonic Response, Quick Insight
Play: 
Trash:
Effects:
 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
Start
Play: Pushing the Limits enters play, followed by a Quick Insight. Lightspeed Barrage, Blinding Speed & Hypersonic Assault are drawn, discarding Sonic Vortex and Supersonic Response
Power: Rapid Recon reveals Hypersonic Assault, keep it
Draw: Hypersonic Assault and Fleet of Foot
End
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
HP: 22
Hand: Lightspeed Barrage, Blinding Speed, Hypersonic Assault, Hypersonic Assault, Fleet of Foot
Play: Pushing the Limits
Trash: Sonic Vortex, Supersonic Response, Quick Insight (2 Burst cards)
Effects:  Play 1 extra card, Draw 1 extra card, Start of turn take 2 sonic damage or destroy PtL
 

Wow! I completely changed my hand, I don't remember doing that before.

I can now clear out Return with the Dawn next turn (Oh, I see Setback can too).

Citizen Dawn (80) [Leader of the Citizens of the Sun]

Citizen Winter (4)
Citizen Anvil (2)
Citizen Assault (4)
Return With the Dawn (ongoing)

Start of Turn:

End of Turn:
Citizen Dawn hits Setback/Fanatic for 5 Energy damage
Citizen Blood hits Omnitron-X for 3 Melee damage
Citizen Winter hits all hero targets for 4 Cold damage (Omnitron-X takes 2, but its deployed component goes BOOM)
Citizen Assault hits all hero targets for 4 Melee damage
Citizen Battery hits Setback/Fanatic for 7 Energy damage

========================
Effects:
- Increase damage dealt by citizens by 1. (Advanced Citizen Dawn)

(Start of Turn)
- If there are five or more villains in the villain trash; flip Citizen Dawn's card.  
  (She may only flip once this way per game.) (Citizen Dawn)

(End of Turn)
- Citizen Dawn deals the hero target with the highest HP 3 Energy damage (Citizen Dawn)
- Citizen Blood deals the hero target with the lowest HP 1 Melee damage (Citizen Blood)
- Citizen Winter deals each hero target 2 Cold damage (Citizen Winter)
- Reduce damage dealt to citizens by 1 (Citizen Anvil)
- Citizen Assault deals each hero target 1 Melee damage (Citizen Assault).
- If Citizen Battery is in play increase damage dealt by Citizen Assault by 1. (Citizen Assault)  
- Shuffle the villain trash and reveal cards from the top until a citizen is revealed.  Put it in play. (Return With the Dawn)
- Citizen Battery deals the hero target with the highest HP 3 energy damage (Citizen Battery)
- If Citizen Assault is in play increase damage dealt by Citizen Battery by 2 (Citizen Battery)

==========
Citizen Dawn  (80)  (DR -1)
Citizen Blood (5)   (DR -1)
Citizen Winter (4)  (DR -1)
Citizen Anvil (2)   (DR -1)
Citizen Assault (4) (DR -1)
Citizen Battery (7) (DR -1)

==========
Fanatic    - 12/10
Setback    - 10/12
Tachyon    - 14
Omnitron-X -  9 (DR -2 for cold, fire, lightning, energy)
Parse      - 13

===========
(none)
 

---

Need decision on who takes the 5 damage between Fanatic and Setback.  The other takes the 7 damage at the end of the turn from Battery.

Villain damage is +2 due to (advanced Dawn) + (Imbued Fraility).  Assault and Battery synergy added 1 to the mass attack and 2 to Battery's attack.

A thumping by the villains, but the +1 DR from the environment means that even without Anvil being taken out Tachyon will be able to hit everyone with Hypersonic Assault.
